text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-89123 — service=hosted-inference.us-west | symptom=p99 latency > 1.5s for last 5m :rotating_light:

pagerduty: page triggered -> PD-89123 (urgent)

oncall-ana: acked. i'm taking this. starting triage — checking dashboards and recent deploys.

mike: thx ana. any customer-facing errors?

oncall-ana: no 5xx spikes in logs, just long tail token times. p95 ~ 800ms, p99 ~ 1.9s on /v1/generate (us-west).

lucy: seeing increased KV cache evictions on sidecar-host-*-usw. heap pressure earlier. suspicious hotkey pattern for some system prompts. details: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/latency?orgId=1

oncall-ana: good catch. lucy, can you dump hotkey list and top prefixes?

lucy: ran quick query: top prefixes by volume -> ["/search", "/chat/sys/summary", "/generate-long"] — one key >> others. Eviction rate jumped at 1711111800.

oncall-ana: checking autoscaler events and recent config changes.

sam-sre: autoscaler did a scale-up but pods remained CPU-limited due to tokenizer spikes. also seeing tokenizer coldstart bursts for long sequences.

oncall-ana: mitigation plan: 1) enable temporary routing to fallback model variant (quantized-medium) for non-critical routes, 2) pin hotkey clients to dedicated pool if possible, 3) warm KV cache for top prefixes. I'll try (1) now.

mike: +1. runbook says quick model-swap command: `rbctl route set-fallback --service hosted-inference --region usw --variant quantized-medium --filter "route != enterprise-a"`

oncall-ana: running command...

```
rbctl route set-fallback --service hosted-inference --region usw --variant quantized-medium --filter "route != enterprise-a"
# started at 1711112380
```

oncall-ana: routing change pushed. monitoring p95/p99.

lucy: started targeted cache-warm job for top 50 prefixes. small burst traffic synthetic to populate KV.

oncall-ana: p99 dropping -> 1.9s -> 1.2s at 1711112460. p95 -> 520ms.

sam-sre: autoscaler hints: add temporary tokenization parallelism for tokenizer service, increasing workers from 4 -> 8; rolling restart scheduled to apply.

mike: are any customers impacted for > 30s? CS notified?

oncall-ana: quick customer check: no major errors, a couple of slow internal jobs flagged. notifying CS with note: short p99 blip, mitigated with model fallback & cache warm.

lucy: eviction rate down, KV hit ratio up 15%.

oncall-ana: follow-ups: 1) postmortem if this recurs, 2) evaluate hotkey sharding and cache sizing, 3) consider tokenizer optimizations for long sequences.

pagerduty: PD-89123 -> acknowledged by oncall-ana. escalation stopped.

oncall-ana: closing thread in 10m if stable. :white_check_mark:

mike: thanks team. please add note to the nightly incident digest.

oncall-ana: will do.
